claim: At 24 °C and 70 %RH, air at sea-level pressure holds about 13.1 g of water vapour per kg of dry air.
reasoning: DERIVED: Hyland-Wexler saturation pressure at 24 °C = 2.985 kPa; vapour pressure = 0.70 x 2.985 = 2.090 kPa; humidity ratio = 0.621945 x 2.090 / (101.325 - 2.090) = 13.10 g/kg. Our own arithmetic from a published method, so JUSTIFIED rather than VERIFIED.
best_available_source: Hyland-Wexler saturation vapour pressure formulation (ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals, Psychrometrics chapter), cited by name
